caption: The drawing depicts the upper torso and head of a female figure rendered with shades of brown, black, and gold. She has dark, wavy hair parted in the middle and styled close to her head. Her skin is a medium brown, and her eyes are large and directed forward. She is adorned with a gold necklace that includes a larger disk-shaped pendant at the center. Her clothing, visible only on her shoulders and upper chest, is brown with some lighter and darker tonal variations suggesting folds or texture. The background is plain and beige, and the lower portion of the composition is interrupted by a horizontal strip and triangle of yellowish color, possibly representing missing or damaged paper. There are faint handwritten notes in the lower right corner.
title: Stern Piece: Pocahontas
